records.name: Early blight
records.sourceOrganization: American Phytopathological Society
records.diagnostics: Ask a crop diagnostician to inspect target-like concentric lesions on leaves, stems or fruit; laboratory review distinguishes look-alike blights.
records.conditions: Collect canopy wetness and local weather observations; these alone do not establish infection.
records.prevention: Use local integrated disease management advice and monitor older foliage and planting material.
records.management: Obtain diagnosis and current India-registered crop-specific guidance before any product application.
records.causes: Possible pathogen or pest; competing abiotic causes remain possible.
records.severity: Severity requires field inspection; matching symptoms are not confirmation.
records.geographicApplicability: Preliminary differential recognition; locally qualified review required
records.evidenceLimitations: Symptom agreement is unconfirmed and uncalibrated. Regional prevalence, treatment validity and diagnostic performance have not been validated.

records.name: Bacterial wilt
records.sourceOrganization: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
records.diagnostics: Rapid wilting needs expert stem/root examination and pathogen testing; Fusarium and moisture stress are alternatives.
records.conditions: Record soil moisture, drainage, planting history and the speed of wilting.
records.prevention: Discuss locally suitable rotations and healthy planting material with extension staff.
records.management: Confirm the cause before treatment; symptom agreement does not establish bacterial infection.
records.causes: Possible pathogen or pest; competing abiotic causes remain possible.
records.severity: Severity requires field inspection; matching symptoms are not confirmation.
records.geographicApplicability: Preliminary differential recognition; locally qualified review required
records.evidenceLimitations: Symptom agreement is unconfirmed and uncalibrated. Regional prevalence, treatment validity and diagnostic performance have not been validated.

records.name: Powdery mildew
records.sourceOrganization: University of California IPM
records.diagnostics: Inspect both leaf surfaces and obtain specialist identification of powdery growth; residue and other leaf disorders can resemble mildew.
records.conditions: Temperature, humidity and canopy conditions can support investigation but do not confirm disease.
records.prevention: Inspect leaves regularly and obtain locally applicable canopy management advice.
records.management: Source supports differential recognition; California pesticide guidance is not an India-registered product recommendation.
records.causes: Possible pathogen or pest; competing abiotic causes remain possible.
records.severity: Severity requires field inspection; matching symptoms are not confirmation.
records.geographicApplicability: Preliminary differential recognition; locally qualified review required
records.evidenceLimitations: Symptom agreement is unconfirmed and uncalibrated. Regional prevalence, treatment validity and diagnostic performance have not been validated.

records.name: Fruit borer damage
records.sourceOrganization: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
records.diagnostics: Inspect damaged fruit for feeding holes and larvae; ask an adviser to identify the pest before management.
records.conditions: Record crop stage and observed insects; poor fruit formation alone is nonspecific.
records.prevention: Scout fruit and conserve beneficial insects through locally advised integrated pest management.
records.management: No insecticide or dose is inferred from fruit damage; use current registered local guidance.
